library.description: Explicit record archival over borrowed transactional hot and blob cold storage

blocks.text: 把不常访问的旧记录从日常读写的热存储移到 blob 对象存储，减少热表需要保留的历史数据，同时保留按原键读取和显式恢复的入口。将插件接到已安装的热后端和对象后端后，由应用主动运行归档规则；归档按段提交，不把整个任务当成跨存储事务。

items: 热表越来越大，定期删除旧记录却让历史查询失去数据。
上传归档后记录已被业务修改，按旧快照删除会丢掉新值。
一次归档中途失败，不知道前面哪些记录已经提交。
恢复完成后冷对象仍占空间，没有引用关系可判断何时能清理。
冷对象上传后重读热值，只移动仍未改变且匹配规则的记录，见按保留时间归档。
读取优先使用热值，显式恢复不会覆盖并发热写，见读取恢复与清理。
进度只统计确定提交的记录和段，中途失败仍可观察，见观察提交进度。
显式 sweep 只删除本插件的无引用冷对象，见读取恢复与清理。

Memory、SQLite、PostgreSQL 可作热层；IndexedDB 热层不支持在事务期间执行冷层 I/O，安装时在冷 I/O 前拒绝。冷层需提供 blob。插件不创建驱动、不替换热层事务，也不独立关闭借用的后端。

blocks.text: id 决定扩展函数前缀；hot/cold 指此前安装的 backend id。rules 非空，name 必须唯一；prefix 是字符串键前缀。olderThanMs 是非负安全整数，where(cutoffMs) 接收本次运行一次采样的当前时间减保留时长，返回记录筛选条件。日期判断由 where 显式表达，插件不会猜测记录哪个字段是时间。
segmentBytes 默认 1,048,576，按未压缩 UTF-8 行字节计算，必须为正安全整数。超大单条记录独立成段。rule 可选，只执行该命名规则；省略按声明顺序执行。limit 可选，必须为正安全整数，只累计所有已选规则的匹配候选，同一键不重复计数。
归档把记录写为不可变 gzip NDJSON 段，上传完成后进入热层事务，核对冷对象、重读热记录、更新归档引用，再删除未改变且仍匹配的热值。并发变化会计入 skipped，不删除新值。没有跨热冷两层的全局事务：前段成功、后段失败时，前段保持提交，遗留冷对象留给显式 Sweep。
归档不是后台任务，也不是自动到期删除。应用决定何时调用 Run；生产环境使用持久热冷后端，内存示例随进程结束丢失数据。

blocks.text: Get 先读取热值；没有热值时查归档引用并读取对应段。它验证完整 gzip/NDJSON 到 EOF，再有限复核一次热值和引用，不能只拿到目标行就提前宣告成功。restore 默认 false；true 在热层事务中恢复且不覆盖并发热写。缺失返回 undefined。
Map/Set 使用 collections codec 往返；字节返回带标签 portable 表示，Date 和函数不支持。不要把归档当作任意 JavaScript 对象快照。
Sweep 通过 blob 原生 opaque 分页扫描本插件前缀，只有 format/version 元数据匹配且热层引用数为 0 的段才删除。它不逐段扫描所有记录清单，不删除仍被引用的段，也不替代 blob 后端自身的原生存储清理。scanned 是列出的候选数，removed 是实际成功删除数。重复 Sweep 可以返回 0。

返回值 archived/skipped/segments 只计入确定提交的结果。后续段失败不会回滚这些数字。beforeArchiveRun 提供规则数和可选 limit；onArchiveRunError 提供已提交进度与可取得的 code；afterArchiveRestore 提供 restored；afterArchiveSweep 提供 scanned/removed。hooks 只观察，异常或拒绝交给 report，不修改归档结果。

blocks.text: 原生错误类型与原错误仍可从 cause/errors 链读取。已有 host/contract 的关闭、冲突和已编码取消保持原对象。本包产生的 Run 失败带 progress；不可扩展的原冲突不附加字段，通过 onArchiveRunError 读取已提交进度。不要把失败后的进度解释为整个任务回滚，也不要未核实就重放未知的原生提交。
热层需 records、迭代、事务和所需控制锁，Memory/SQLite/PostgreSQL 支持；IndexedDB 安装在冷 I/O 前拒绝。冷层需 blob，压缩环境须支持 gzip。插件不独立关闭驱动或热冷后端；只释放 host 即可走其正常关闭流程。连接池等调用方资源按其真实客户端 API 释放。

Move rarely read records out of the storage used for everyday updates and into blob storage, while keeping reads by original key and an explicit restore operation. Connect the plugin to installed hot and object backends, then run archive rules when your application chooses. Each segment commits separately; the whole archive job is not a transaction across both stores.

items: Hot tables grow, but deleting old records makes historical queries lose data.
A record changes after archive upload, so deleting the earlier snapshot would lose the new value.
An archive job fails halfway through without showing what already committed.
Cold objects remain after restoration because there is no way to tell which ones are still referenced.
After upload, it rereads hot values and moves only unchanged records that still match. See Archive by retention time.
Reads prefer hot values; explicit restore does not overwrite concurrent hot writes. See Read restore and clean up.
Progress includes only certainly committed records and segments. See Observe committed progress.
Explicit sweep removes only this plugin's unreferenced archive objects. See Read restore and clean up.

blocks.text: With id archive, the functions are archiveRun, archiveGet and archiveSweep. With id history, they are historyRun, historyGet and historySweep. There is no nested archive object or extension-specific dispose.

Memory, SQLite and PostgreSQL can supply hot storage. IndexedDB cannot perform cold I/O during its transaction and rejects installation before cold I/O. Cold storage must supply blob. The plugin creates no drivers and does not replace hot transactions or independently close borrowed backends.

Segments commit separately; later failures do not roll back earlier segments. Explicit Sweep removes unreferenced cold objects. Get does not restore by default. Sweep neither archives nor deletes records by age. Error source is storage.backend.archive. See the usage guide for rules, cancellation and failure progress.

blocks.text: id sets extension-function prefixes. hot/cold are previously installed backend IDs. rules must be nonempty, with unique names and string-key prefixes. olderThanMs is a nonnegative safe integer. where(cutoffMs) receives one sampled current time minus retention and returns the record condition. The condition explicitly chooses a time field; the plugin never guesses one.

segmentBytes defaults to 1,048,576 uncompressed UTF-8 row bytes and must be a positive safe integer. An oversized record gets its own segment. Optional rule selects one named rule; omission runs declaration order. Optional limit is a positive safe integer counting matching candidates across selected rules. The same key is not counted twice.

Records become immutable gzip NDJSON segments. After upload, a hot transaction checks the object, rereads candidates, updates archive references and deletes only unchanged values that still match. Concurrent changes count as skipped instead of deleting new data. There is no global hot/cold transaction. If a later segment fails, earlier segments remain committed and unused cold objects await explicit Sweep.

Archive is an explicit operation, without a background scheduler or automatic age deletion. The application decides when to call Run. Use persistent backends for production; the in-memory example loses data when its process ends.
Referenced cold segments remain. Once the last record is restored, Sweep can reclaim its segment.

blocks.code:

blocks.text: Get reads hot storage first. If absent, it reads the archive reference and segment. It validates complete gzip/NDJSON through EOF, then performs one bounded recheck of the hot value/reference. Finding the requested line is not enough to declare success. restore defaults to false. true restores in a hot transaction without overwriting a concurrent hot write. Missing values return undefined.
Map/Set use the collections codec. Bytes return its tagged portable representation. Date and functions are unsupported; archives are not arbitrary JavaScript-object snapshots.

Sweep uses native opaque blob pages within this plugin's prefix. It deletes only objects with matching format/version metadata and zero hot references. It does not scan every record manifest for every segment, delete referenced objects, or replace the blob backend's own native storage cleanup. scanned counts listed candidates; removed counts actual successful deletions. A repeated Sweep can return 0.
With id history, the flat functions are historyRun, historyGet and historySweep. Organization views call them normally.

blocks.text: Operations use the invoking organization and project both hot/cold into it. Do not pass a different orgId in options; mismatched context rejects. Identical root and organization string keys remain separate. There is no host.backend('history') or extensions.history.run().
afterArchiveRun observes a successful result; business code should still use returned progress.
Expected output:

archived/skipped/segments count only certainly committed results. A later failure does not roll those counts back. beforeArchiveRun provides the rule count and optional limit. onArchiveRunError provides committed progress and an available code. afterArchiveRestore reports restored; afterArchiveSweep reports scanned/removed. Hooks observe only. Throws/rejections are reported without changing the operation result.

Run accepts rule, limit and operation context such as signal/timeoutMs/pageSize. Get adds restore; Sweep accepts only operation context. Cancellation stops later work while committed segments remain. Host shutdown waits for accepted physical work; early caller cancellation is not physical completion.

rows: Invalid installation configuration; fix IDs, backend references or rules.
Invalid runtime key, rule name or limit.
An explicit operation failed; inspect cause and committed progress.
Invalid cold segment/private metadata; the parsing failure remains reachable.
A backend lacks a required capability; IndexedDB cannot hold its transaction across arbitrary cold I/O.

blocks.text: Native error classes and original errors remain reachable through cause/errors. Existing host/contract shutdown, conflict and coded-cancellation errors retain their objects. Archive-created Run failures carry progress. Nonextensible original conflicts do not receive extra fields; read committed progress from onArchiveRunError. Failure progress does not mean the whole job rolled back. Verify native state before replaying an unknown commit.

Hot storage needs records, iteration, transactions and the required control lock. Memory, SQLite and PostgreSQL support them; IndexedDB installation rejects before cold I/O. Cold storage needs blob and the runtime needs gzip support. Archive does not independently close drivers or hot/cold backends. Dispose the host through its normal shutdown path and release caller-managed connection pools through their actual client APIs.
